cīyati.p: [Cīya+a+ti] (kri) CL=10 Increases. Cīyati (kamma,kri) [ci+ya+te; te > ti; i > ī]. Be collected.

[√ci 1 ; S. cinoti], heaps up, piles up; constructs; accumulates ; Dhātup 496 (ci caye); Dhātum 716; Ja II 302, 5 (dve pitāputtā naḷakārā kilañjaṃ ~anti, Be, Ce, Ee so, but prob. wr for vinanti; Se vīnanti); VI 432, 2 (pākāraṃ ~anti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ācinanti); Sp 570, 24 (paṃsuṃ uddharati ~āti, Be, Ce so; Ee cinatī ti; Se minātī ti); 1276, 28 (pamādaṃ ~ātī ti anuciṇṇo, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce anucinātī ti); Spk II 296, 21 (apacināti no ācinātī ti vaṭṭaṃ vināseti n’ eva ~āti); As 63, 34 (javanavīthivasena attano santānaṃ ~otī ti cittaṃ); Sadd 493, 24 (ci caye, ṇakārassa nakārattaṃ, pākāraṃ ~oti); 495, 23 (ci caye: puññaṃ ~āti pākāraṃ ~āti); — part.pr. cinanta, mf (~antī) n. , Ap-a 265, 34 foll. ( mfn. ) ( i ) heaped, piled up; built; accumulated ; Vin II 159, 34 (tena akusalakena ~ā vaṅkā bhitti paripati); D II 178, 27 (pokkharaṇīyo … iṭṭhakāhi ~ā ahesuṃ); A IV 402, 27 (yato kho āvuso bhikkhuno cetasā citaṃ hoti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee cetasā cittaṃ paricitaṃ hoti; Mp IV 191, 14 : cittavārapariyāyena cittavārapariyāyo ~o vaḍḍhito hoti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee cittācārapariyāyena cittācārapariyāyo); Spk III 251, 16 (paricitā ti samantato ~ā suvaḍḍhitā); Pj I 221, 31 (cayitabban ti cetiyaṃ … ~-ttā vā cetiyaṃ); As 44, 20 (~aṃ ~aṃ iṭṭhakaṃ viddhaṃsayamāno puriso viya); 63, 35 (vipākaṃ kammakilesehi ~an ti cittaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr cittan ti); Mhv 30:51 (pupphādhānattayaṃ thūpe iṭṭhakāhi ~aṃ ~aṃ samaṃ pathaviyā katvā); Sadd 493, 24 (~aṃ kusalaṃ); 495, 25 (~o pākāro); — ~’-antaraṃsa, mfn. , whose back is flat (ie not hollow) between the shoulder-blades (one of the 32 characteristics of a mahāpurisa ) ; D II 18, 13 (ayaṃ … kumāro ~’-antaraṃso); M II 136, 26 (~’-antaraṃso kho pana so bhavaṃ Gotamo; Ps III 380, 2 : antaraṃsaṃ vuccati dvinnaṃ koṭṭānaṃ antaraṃ, taṃ citaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ assā ti ~’-antaraṃso); — ( ii ) covered ; Ja III 468, 10* (~o bhānumatā-m-iva, Ce, Ee so; Be ṭhito bhāṇumatā-m-iva; Se ṭhito bhāṇumakāsi va; 469, 6´ foll. : vītaccikaṅgārehi samantā parikiṇṇo viya sarīre uṭṭhitena mahāḍāhena ḍayhanto, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee parikiṇṇe); Vv-a 182, 27 (hemajālehi kumbhālaṅkārādibhedehi hatthālaṅkārehi ~aṃ āmuttaṃ … gajaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee cittaṃ); — 2. ( a ) cināpetvā, Ja VI 204, 24´ (iṭṭhakāhi ~etvā āsanāni kāresi); Sp 88, 19 (vatthuṃ ~etvā); ( b ) cināpetvāna, Mhv 17:35 (sukkha-kaddamakhaṇḍehi ~etvāna taṃsamaṃ); — see also ceta(r).
